title: Create ReAutomated+
description: addon for Create ReAutomated expanding modded compatibility
body:
# Create ReAutomated+
_This mod was made for the [Cobalt Clouds](https://discord.gg/VztadsbNqk) modpack and server._

Create ReAutomated+ is an addon for [Create ReAutomated](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-reautomated), adding a new Drill and Ore Nodes:

- Steel Drill [TFMG]

- Redstone Node
- Lead Node [TFMG]
- Nickel Node [TFMG]
- Lithium Node [TFMG]
- Bauxite Node [TFMG]
- Galena Node [TFMG]
- Soulstone Node [Malum]
- Quartz Node [Malum]
- Brilliant Node [Malum]
- Cobalt Node [Cobalt Changes]

- Increases Ore Node spawn heights to better fit Skylands generation
- Replaces Diamond Drill with Steel Drill in recipies


## Requirements
- [KubeJS](https://modrinth.com/mod/kubejs)
- [Kubeloader](https://modrinth.com/mod/kubeloader)
- [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create)
- [Create ReAutomated](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-reautomated)
- [TFMG](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-tfmg)
- [Malum](https://modrinth.com/mod/malum) 
- [Cobalt Changes](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobalt-changes)
